title: Walsh character of a singleton frequency
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The Walsh character indexed by the vector that is $1$ at coordinate $i$ and $0$ elsewhere, evaluated at $x$, equals the binary sign of $x_i$.
